signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Save your itineraries and add climbs. No password: we send you a link.
signIn.sent: Check your inbox: we sent a sign-in link to {{email}}.
signIn.unavailable: Signing in is not available on this server yet.

problems.failed: The link could not be sent. Please try again in a moment.

session.expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to use your account.

account.title: Your account
account.signedOut: Sign in to see your account.
account.flatPaceUnset: Not set yet: it estimates your times on climbs.

deletion.title: Delete my account
deletion.explanation: Deleting your account erases your e-mail, display name, Flat Pace and saved itineraries. The climbs you added stay on ClimbSpot, without your name.
deletion.confirm: Delete your account for good? This cannot be undone.
